items.text: Let it be. Ravick got stuck on "Take chisel" twice, improvised — attacked the drowned man, killed it, and took the rusted chisel on his own, all inside ninety seconds. His prayer was already answered last turn; he's mid-flow and succeeding, so a second voice out of the air would only interrupt. (Worth a note next writing turn: the stair's drowned man is an attackable creature, and killing him is now a second, undesigned route to the chisel.)
